ex.en: I majored in philosophy at my university.
ex.zh: 我在大學主修哲學。

ex.en: Susan is majoring in American history.
ex.zh: 蘇珊主修美國史。

ex.en: What do you plan to major in at college?
ex.zh: 你上大學打算主修什麼？

major.en: to study a particular subject as your main subject at college

ex.en: What's your major?
ex.zh: 你主修什麼？

ex.en: My major is economics.
ex.zh: 我主修經濟。

major.en: the main subject that a student studies at college

ex.en: Traffic is a major problem in this city.
ex.zh: 交通是這座城市的主要問題。

ex.en: She had major surgery last year.
ex.zh: 她去年動了一場大手術。

ex.en: Don't download files from unknown sites; they may contain malware.
ex.zh: 別從來路不明的網站下載檔案，裡面可能有惡意軟體。

ex.en: Antivirus software can detect most malware.
ex.zh: 防毒軟體可以偵測到大多數惡意軟體。

malware.en: computer software made to damage or steal from other people's computers

ex.en: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.
ex.zh: 塑膠已經取代了許多傳統材料。

ex.en: I'm going to go buy some materials today.
ex.zh: 我今天要去買一些材料。

material.en: a substance that things are made from

ex.en: She is collecting material for a book.
ex.zh: 她在為一本書蒐集資料。

ex.en: I haven't yet collected sufficient materials to write a book.
ex.zh: 我還沒蒐集到足夠的資料來寫書。

material.en: information or ideas that are used for a book, article or other work

ex.en: Not material, but spiritual things determine our life.
ex.zh: 決定我們生活的不是物質，而是精神。

ex.en: He doesn't care much about material things.
ex.zh: 他不太在乎物質上的東西。

material.en: related to physical things rather than to thoughts or feelings

ex.en: Such manuals should be written in simpler language.
ex.zh: 這類說明書應該用更淺顯的文字來寫。

ex.en: If only I read the user manual properly.
ex.zh: 要是我當初有好好看使用手冊就好了。

ex.en: She was reading a gardening manual.
ex.zh: 她正在看一本園藝手冊。

manual.en: a book that explains how to use a machine or do something

ex.en: Can you drive a manual transmission?
ex.zh: 你會開手排車嗎？

ex.en: I'm unable to do manual labour.
ex.zh: 我沒辦法做體力活。

ex.en: The system still requires a lot of manual data entry.
ex.zh: 這個系統仍需要大量手動輸入資料。

manual.en: done or operated by hand rather than by machine, or needing physical work

ex.en: I'd like to go to the mall.
ex.zh: 我想去購物中心。

ex.en: This shopping mall is one mile ahead.
ex.zh: 這間購物中心就在前方一英里處。

ex.en: Is there a mall near here?
ex.zh: 這附近有購物中心嗎？

mall.en: a large building with many shops inside

ex.en: The man wore a mask of a tiger.
ex.zh: 那個男人戴著老虎面具。

ex.en: He wore a mask so that no one could recognize him.
ex.zh: 他戴著面具，所以沒人認得出他。

mask.en: a covering for the face that hides or changes how you look

ex.en: Tom took off his mask.
ex.zh: 湯姆把口罩拿下來了。

ex.en: Please wear a mask on the bus.
ex.zh: 搭公車時請戴口罩。

mask.en: a cover for the nose and mouth that protects against germs or dirt

ex.en: She tried to mask her disappointment.
ex.zh: 她試著掩飾自己的失望。

ex.en: The air freshener masked the smell.
ex.zh: 芳香劑蓋過了那股味道。

mask.en: to hide a feeling or fact so that others cannot see it

ex.en: My classmate, Xiao Ming, has strong managerial capability.
ex.zh: 我同學小明的管理能力很強。

ex.en: She has ten years of managerial experience.
ex.zh: 她有十年的管理經驗。

ex.en: He was promoted to a managerial position.
ex.zh: 他被升為管理職。

managerial.en: related to the work of running a company or a team

ex.en: I want a massage. I need to relax.
ex.zh: 我想去按摩，我需要放鬆一下。

ex.en: She gave him a massage.
ex.zh: 她幫他按摩。

ex.en: She works as a massage therapist.
ex.zh: 她是按摩師。

massage.en: the action of rubbing and pressing the body to relieve pain or help it relax

ex.en: Gently massage the cream into your skin.
ex.zh: 把乳霜輕輕按摩到皮膚裡。

ex.en: My neck hurts. Can you massage it for me?
ex.zh: 我脖子好痠，可以幫我按摩一下嗎？

massage.en: to rub and press someone's body, or to rub something into the skin

ex.en: We need to maximize profits this year.
ex.zh: 我們今年需要讓獲利最大化。

ex.en: The new layout maximizes the use of space.
ex.zh: 新的配置讓空間得到最充分的利用。

maximize.en: to make something as large or as good as possible

ex.en: Click here to maximize the window.
ex.zh: 點這裡把視窗放到最大。

ex.en: Maximize the browser so you can see the whole page.
ex.zh: 把瀏覽器放到最大，才能看到整個頁面。

maximize.en: to make a window on a computer screen fill the whole screen

ma'am.zh: 女士、小姐（對女性的尊稱）

ex.en: Excuse me, ma'am, you dropped your wallet.
ex.zh: 女士，不好意思，您的錢包掉了。

ex.en: Can I help you, ma'am?
ex.zh: 女士，有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

ma'am.en: a polite way to speak to a woman

ex.en: She showed great maturity for her age.
ex.zh: 以她的年紀來說，她非常成熟。

ex.en: Emotional maturity is important for leaders.
ex.zh: 情緒成熟對領導者很重要。

maturity.en: the quality of thinking and acting like a sensible adult

ex.en: The bond reaches maturity in five years.
ex.zh: 這張債券五年後到期。

ex.en: You will receive the full amount at maturity.
ex.zh: 到期時你會拿到全額。

maturity.en: the time when a loan or insurance plan ends and the money must be paid

ex.en: There is only a marginal difference between the two.
ex.zh: 兩者之間只有些微的差異。

ex.en: The new policy had only a marginal effect on sales.
ex.zh: 新政策對銷售只有些微的影響。

ex.en: Profits saw a marginal increase this year.
ex.zh: 今年利潤略有增加。

marginal.en: very small in size or importance

marketer.zh: 行銷人員；（產品的）銷售商

ex.en: Marketers use social media to reach young customers.
ex.zh: 行銷人員利用社群媒體接觸年輕顧客。

ex.en: She works as a digital marketer for a tech firm.
ex.zh: 她在一家科技公司擔任數位行銷人員。

marketer.en: a person or company that advertises and sells products

matrix.zh: 矩陣；（組織的）矩陣式結構

ex.en: We use a decision matrix to compare the options.
ex.zh: 我們用決策矩陣來比較各個選項。

ex.en: The company has a matrix structure with two bosses.
ex.zh: 這家公司採矩陣式結構，有兩位主管。

matrix.en: a table of numbers or items in rows and columns, or a system with crossing lines of responsibility

ex.en: The company must compete in a global marketplace.
ex.zh: 公司必須在全球市場上競爭。

ex.en: I sold my old bike on an online marketplace.
ex.zh: 我在網路交易平台賣掉了舊腳踏車。

marketplace.en: a place, in person or online, where goods are bought and sold

ex.en: The government has a mandate to reform taxes.
ex.zh: 政府獲得民意授權改革稅制。

ex.en: The committee's mandate is to review safety rules.
ex.zh: 委員會的任務是檢討安全規定。

mandate.en: the official power to do something, given to a leader or group by voters

ex.en: The law mandates safety training for all staff.
ex.zh: 法律規定所有員工都要受安全訓練。

ex.en: Masks were mandated on public transport.
ex.zh: 大眾運輸上曾強制戴口罩。

mandate.en: to officially order that something must be done

ex.en: Macroeconomic conditions affect consumer spending.
ex.zh: 總體經濟情勢會影響消費支出。

ex.en: The bank publishes a macroeconomic report every quarter.
ex.zh: 這家銀行每季發表總體經濟報告。

macroeconomic.en: related to the economy of a whole country or of the whole world

ex.en: He is good at solving complicated mathematical problems.
ex.zh: 他擅長解複雜的數學題。

ex.en: Einstein was a mathematical genius.
ex.zh: 愛因斯坦是數學天才。

mathematical.en: related to the study of numbers and shapes

ex.en: Electric cars are entering the mainstream.
ex.zh: 電動車正逐漸成為主流。

ex.en: His ideas are far from the mainstream.
ex.zh: 他的想法跟主流相去甚遠。

mainstream.en: the ideas or ways of living that most people accept

ex.en: Mainstream media did not report the story.
ex.zh: 主流媒體沒有報導這件事。

ex.en: The band became popular with mainstream audiences.
ex.zh: 這個樂團受到一般大眾歡迎。

mainstream.en: accepted by most people and not unusual

ex.en: We didn't realize the magnitude of the problem.
ex.zh: 我們當時沒意識到問題有多嚴重。

ex.en: Nobody expected a project of this magnitude.
ex.zh: 沒有人料到會有這麼大規模的專案。

magnitude.en: the large size or great importance of something

ex.en: A massive earthquake of magnitude 8.8 hit the Japanese islands today.
ex.zh: 今天，一場規模 8.8 的強烈地震襲擊了日本列島。

ex.en: The earthquake had a magnitude of 6.5.
ex.zh: 這次地震規模為 6.5。

magnitude.en: a number that shows how strong an earthquake is or how bright a star is

ex.en: I'm taking a course in macroeconomics this semester.
ex.zh: 我這學期修了一門總體經濟學。

ex.en: Macroeconomics studies inflation, growth, and unemployment.
ex.zh: 總體經濟學研究通膨、成長和失業。

macroeconomics.en: the study of the economy of a whole country or of the whole world

ex.en: The new rules will not materially affect our business.
ex.zh: 新規定不會對我們的業務造成實質影響。

ex.en: The results did not change materially.
ex.zh: 結果並沒有重大改變。

materially.en: in a way that is important enough to make a real difference

ex.en: They are materially comfortable but not happy.
ex.zh: 他們物質生活優渥，卻不快樂。

ex.en: Materially, we have everything we need.
ex.zh: 在物質上，我們什麼都不缺。

materially.en: in a way that is related to money and things you own

ex.en: He tried to manipulate the data to look better.
ex.zh: 他試圖操弄數據讓結果好看一點。

ex.en: Don't let anyone manipulate you.
ex.zh: 不要讓任何人操控你。

manipulate.en: to control or change people or information in a clever, often dishonest way

ex.en: This software lets you manipulate images easily.
ex.zh: 這套軟體讓你能輕鬆編修影像。

ex.en: Robots can manipulate small parts with great precision.
ex.zh: 機器人能非常精準地操作小零件。

manipulate.en: to handle or change something skillfully

ex.en: The ferry runs between the island and the mainland.
ex.zh: 渡輪往返於島嶼和本土之間。

ex.en: Prices on the island are higher than on the mainland.
ex.zh: 島上的物價比本土高。

mainland.en: the main area of land of a country, not including its islands

ex.en: Profit maximization is the main goal of the firm.
ex.zh: 利潤最大化是這家公司的主要目標。

ex.en: The strategy focuses on revenue maximization.
ex.zh: 這項策略著重於營收最大化。

maximization.en: the act of making something as large or as good as possible

ex.en: Macro factors such as interest rates affect our sales.
ex.zh: 利率等總體因素會影響我們的銷售。

ex.en: Let's look at the macro picture before the details.
ex.zh: 我們先看整體大局，再看細節。

macro.en: related to large things or to the whole of something

ex.en: I wrote a macro to create the report automatically.
ex.zh: 我寫了一個巨集來自動產生報表。

ex.en: Excel macros can save you a lot of time.
ex.zh: Excel 巨集可以幫你省下很多時間。

macro.en: a short set of computer commands that does a long task automatically

ex.en: Fluency in English is a very marketable skill today.
ex.zh: 英文流利是現今非常搶手的技能。

ex.en: We need to make the product more marketable.
ex.zh: 我們需要讓這個產品更有市場。

marketable.en: easy to sell because people want it

ex.en: The report accused the company of price manipulation.
ex.zh: 報告指控這家公司操縱價格。

ex.en: Emotional manipulation can damage a relationship.
ex.zh: 情緒操控會傷害一段關係。

manipulation.en: the act of controlling or changing people or things in a clever, unfair way

ex.en: This tool makes data manipulation much easier.
ex.zh: 這個工具讓資料處理容易得多。

ex.en: Image manipulation software is easy to use now.
ex.zh: 現在的修圖軟體很容易上手。

manipulation.en: the act of handling or changing data or images with skill

ex.en: Bad weather marred the opening ceremony.
ex.zh: 惡劣的天氣破壞了開幕典禮。

ex.en: One small mistake marred an otherwise perfect report.
ex.zh: 一個小錯誤讓原本完美的報告美中不足。

mar.en: to spoil something good or beautiful

maneuver.zh: （巧妙的）動作、操作法；策略、手段

ex.en: Do you know the Heimlich maneuver?
ex.zh: 你知道哈姆立克急救法嗎？

ex.en: Hiring her away was a smart business maneuver.
ex.zh: 把她挖角過來是很聰明的商業手段。

maneuver.en: a skillful or planned movement or action

ex.en: Sami didn't have time to maneuver.
ex.zh: 薩米來不及閃避。

ex.en: It was hard to maneuver the car into the tiny parking space.
ex.zh: 要把車開進那個小車位很難。

maneuver.en: to move something carefully into a position, or to use clever plans to get what you want

ex.en: Magnetic fields are invisible.
ex.zh: 磁場是看不見的。

ex.en: Keep the magnetic card away from your phone.
ex.zh: 磁卡要遠離手機。

magnetic.en: having the power to pull metal objects toward it

ex.en: She has a magnetic personality.
ex.zh: 她的個性很有魅力。

ex.en: The singer's magnetic stage presence won over the crowd.
ex.zh: 這位歌手極具魅力的台風征服了觀眾。

magnetic.en: attracting people strongly because of being charming

ex.en: Nothing is so tasty as the dish you make.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼比你做的菜更好吃了。

ex.en: I'll make some coffee.
ex.zh: 我來泡點咖啡。

ex.en: You must be careful not to make him angry.
ex.zh: 你要小心，別惹他生氣。

ex.en: The mere thought of a snake makes me shiver.
ex.zh: 一想到蛇我就發抖。

make.en: to cause someone or something to do or feel something

ex.en: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.
ex.zh: 你一再犯同樣的錯誤。

ex.en: We need to make a decision today.
ex.zh: 我們今天必須做出決定。

make.en: to do or produce something such as a mistake, a choice or a plan

ex.en: She makes about 5,000 dollars a month.
ex.zh: 她一個月大約賺五千美元。

ex.en: The company made a profit last year.
ex.zh: 公司去年有獲利。

make.zh: make it：及時趕到；能出席；成功

ex.en: We made it to the airport just in time.
ex.zh: 我們及時趕到了機場。

ex.en: Can you make it to the meeting at three?
ex.zh: 你三點能來開會嗎？

make.en: to arrive on time, to be able to come, or to succeed

ex.en: I may have left my umbrella in the bus.
ex.zh: 我可能把雨傘忘在公車上了。

ex.en: This story may sound strange, but it's absolutely true.
ex.zh: 這個故事聽起來可能很奇怪，但卻是千真萬確的。

ex.en: Take your time, or you may make some mistakes.
ex.zh: 慢慢來，不然你可能會出錯。

may.en: used to say that something is possible

ex.en: You may stay here as long as you like.
ex.zh: 你想在這裡待多久都可以。

ex.en: May I come in?
ex.zh: 我可以進來嗎？

may.en: used to say that someone is allowed to do something

ex.en: You may as well tell me all about it.
ex.zh: 你不妨把事情全部告訴我。

ex.en: We may as well start now.
ex.zh: 我們不如現在就開始。

may.en: used to say that doing something is a fine choice because there is no better one

ex.en: My birthday is in May.
ex.zh: 我的生日在五月。

ex.en: The conference will be held in May.
ex.zh: 研討會將在五月舉行。

may.en: the fifth month of the year

ex.en: Science has brought about many changes to our lives.
ex.zh: 科學為我們的生活帶來了許多改變。

ex.en: I am happy to have so many good friends.
ex.zh: 我很高興有這麼多好朋友。

ex.en: English is spoken in many parts of the world.
ex.zh: 世界上許多地方都說英語。

many.en: a large number of people or things

ex.en: Many of my friends live abroad.
ex.zh: 我很多朋友住在國外。

ex.en: Many believe the price will go up.
ex.zh: 許多人認為價格會上漲。

many.en: a large number of people or things

ex.en: How many schools are there in your city?
ex.zh: 你們城市有幾所學校？

ex.en: How many people work here?
ex.zh: 這裡有多少人工作？

many.en: used to ask about the number of people or things

ex.en: Generally speaking, men can run faster than women can.
ex.zh: 一般來說，男人跑得比女人快。

ex.en: We lost sight of the man in the crowd.
ex.zh: 我們在人群中跟丟了那個男人。

ex.en: Mary doesn't like men who are stingy like Tom.
ex.zh: 瑪莉不喜歡像湯姆那樣小氣的男人。

ex.en: England expects that every man will do his duty.
ex.zh: 英國期望每個人都盡到自己的責任。

ex.en: Man is the only animal that uses fire.
ex.zh: 人類是唯一會使用火的動物。

man.en: a human being, or all human beings

ex.en: The booth is manned by two staff members.
ex.zh: 這個攤位由兩名工作人員負責。

ex.en: Who will man the front desk tomorrow?
ex.zh: 明天誰要顧櫃台？

man.en: to work at a place or machine, or to provide people to work there

ex.en: I don't want to be involved in that matter.
ex.zh: 我不想被捲入那件事。

ex.en: Don't interfere with matters that do not concern you!
ex.zh: 不要干涉與你無關的事！

matter.en: a subject or situation that you must think about or deal with

ex.en: Even if it is true, it matters little.
ex.zh: 就算是真的，也沒什麼關係。

ex.en: It doesn't matter what other people think.
ex.zh: 別人怎麼想並不重要。

matter.en: to be important or to have an effect on someone

ex.en: No matter what happens, you must not give up.
ex.zh: 無論發生什麼事，你都不能放棄。

ex.en: No matter what happens, I won't change my mind.
ex.zh: 無論發生什麼事，我都不會改變主意。

matter.en: used to say that something does not change the situation

ex.en: What's the matter with your computer?
ex.zh: 你的電腦怎麼了？

ex.en: What's the matter? You look tired.
ex.zh: 怎麼了？你看起來很累。

matter.en: used to ask what is wrong

ex.en: His main object in life was to become rich.
ex.zh: 他人生的主要目標就是變有錢。

ex.en: One of the main products of this country is coffee.
ex.zh: 咖啡是這個國家的主要產品之一。

ex.en: The main entrance is on the left side of the building.
ex.zh: 大樓的主要入口在左側。

main.en: most important or largest of its kind

ex.en: The water mains burst due to the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震震破了自來水總管。

ex.en: Workers are repairing a broken gas main.
ex.zh: 工人正在修理破裂的瓦斯總管。

main.en: a large pipe or cable that carries water, gas or electricity to buildings

ex.en: My head hurts. Maybe I should take an aspirin.
ex.zh: 我頭痛，也許該吃顆阿斯匹靈。

ex.en: Maybe we can buy Tom a new one.
ex.zh: 也許我們可以買個新的給湯姆。

ex.en: Maybe I should just tell Tom the truth.
ex.zh: 也許我就該直接跟湯姆說實話。

maybe.en: used to say that something is possible but not certain

ex.en: She managed to finish the work on her own.
ex.zh: 她設法靠自己完成了工作。

ex.en: We managed to get it back without her knowing.
ex.zh: 我們設法在她不知情的情況下把它拿回來。

ex.en: How do people manage to sleep on the plane?
ex.zh: 人們是怎麼在飛機上睡得著的？

manage.en: to succeed in doing something difficult

ex.en: He doesn't have the ability to manage that group.
ex.zh: 他沒有能力管理那個團隊。

ex.en: She manages a small restaurant.
ex.zh: 她經營一家小餐廳。

ex.en: He is good at managing his time.
ex.zh: 他很擅長管理時間。

manage.en: to be in charge of a business, a team or a place

ex.en: Management of a company is different from ownership of a company.
ex.zh: 經營一家公司和擁有一家公司是兩回事。

ex.en: Sami doesn't know anything about management.
ex.zh: 薩米對管理一竅不通。

ex.en: The company is starting to implement the new management system from next month.
ex.zh: 公司下個月開始實施新的管理制度。

management.en: the control and organization of a business or activity

ex.en: Japanese management must learn how to deal with American workers, he said.
ex.zh: 他說：「日本管理階層必須學會如何對待美國員工。」

ex.en: Management has approved the new budget.
ex.zh: 管理階層已核准新預算。

management.en: the people who run a company or organization

ex.en: Almost no students get full marks in Chinese classics.
ex.zh: 幾乎沒有學生在古文考試拿到滿分。

ex.en: It is true that he got full marks on the test.
ex.zh: 他考試拿了滿分是真的。

mark.en: a number or letter that a teacher gives for schoolwork

ex.en: The wet vase left a mark on the table.
ex.zh: 濕花瓶在桌上留下了水痕。

ex.en: Put a mark next to the correct answer.
ex.zh: 在正確答案旁做個記號。

mark.en: a spot or line that is left on a surface

ex.en: I marked the important parts in red.
ex.zh: 我用紅色標出重要的部分。

ex.en: Please mark the box if you agree.
ex.zh: 如果同意，請在方框中打勾。

mark.en: to write or draw a sign on something to show something

ex.en: The invention of the transistor marked a new era.
ex.zh: 電晶體的發明開創了一個新時代。

ex.en: The event marks the company's 50th anniversary.
ex.zh: 這場活動是為了紀念公司成立五十週年。

mark.en: to show that something important happens, or to celebrate it

ex.en: The engineer told us how to use the machine.
ex.zh: 工程師告訴我們怎麼使用這台機器。

ex.en: This machine is too heavy for me to carry.
ex.zh: 這台機器太重，我搬不動。

ex.en: The vending machines are over there.
ex.zh: 自動販賣機在那邊。

machine.en: a piece of equipment with moving parts that does a job

ex.en: I have three dogs. One is male and the other two are female.
ex.zh: 我養了三隻狗，一隻是公的，另外兩隻是母的。

ex.en: Every male Algerian citizen must do military service.
ex.zh: 每個阿爾及利亞男性公民都必須服兵役。

ex.en: Most of the male employees wear suits.
ex.zh: 大部分男性員工都穿西裝。

male.en: belonging to the sex that cannot have babies or lay eggs

ex.en: Why are there differences between males and females?
ex.zh: 為什麼男性和女性之間會有差異？

ex.en: The male of this bird has bright feathers.
ex.zh: 這種鳥的雄鳥羽毛很鮮豔。

male.en: a person or animal of the sex that cannot have babies or lay eggs

ex.en: It is hard to maintain one's reputation.
ex.zh: 要維持一個人的名聲很難。

ex.en: We need to maintain high quality standards.
ex.zh: 我們需要維持高品質標準。

maintain.en: to make something continue in the same state

ex.en: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
ex.zh: 雷射印表機的維護成本通常比噴墨印表機低。

ex.en: The building is well maintained.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓維護得很好。

maintain.en: to keep a machine or building in good condition by checking and fixing it

ex.en: She maintains that her analysis is correct.
ex.zh: 她堅稱自己的分析是正確的。

ex.en: Tom maintained his innocence.
ex.zh: 湯姆堅稱自己是無辜的。

maintain.en: to say firmly that something is true

ex.en: Can I have a look at the magazine?
ex.zh: 我可以看一下那本雜誌嗎？

ex.en: Are there any English magazines in this library?
ex.zh: 這間圖書館有英文雜誌嗎？

ex.en: Such magazines have a great influence on children.
ex.zh: 這類雜誌對小孩的影響很大。

magazine.en: a thin book with pictures and articles that comes out every week or month

ex.en: The majority of people marry sooner or later.
ex.zh: 大部分的人遲早會結婚。

ex.en: The majority of his clientele are poor people.
ex.zh: 他的客戶大多是窮人。

ex.en: The majority of our customers are young people.
ex.zh: 我們大多數的顧客都是年輕人。

majority.en: the larger part of a group of people or things

ex.en: The bill passed by a small majority of 10 votes.
ex.zh: 這項法案以十票的些微多數通過。

ex.en: The plan was approved by a large majority.
ex.zh: 這個計畫以壓倒性多數通過。

majority.en: the number of votes by which a side wins

mass.zh: 大量的、大規模的、大眾的

ex.en: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
ex.zh: 大量生產降低了許多商品的價格。

ex.en: This famous mountain climber is a critic of mass tourism.
ex.zh: 這位知名登山家批評大眾觀光。

ex.en: Their small protest triggered a mass demonstration.
ex.zh: 他們的小型抗議引發了一場大規模示威。

mass.en: involving or affecting a very large number of people or things

ex.en: There is a mass of dark clouds in the sky.
ex.zh: 天空有一大片烏雲。

ex.en: A cloud is a mass of vapor in the sky.
ex.zh: 雲是天空中的一團水氣。

mass.en: a large amount or number of something, often with no clear shape

ex.en: Marriage has many pains, but celibacy has no pleasures.
ex.zh: 婚姻有許多痛苦，但單身沒有任何樂趣。

ex.en: She is dependent on her parents even after her marriage.
ex.zh: 她婚後仍然依賴父母。

ex.en: They have a happy marriage.
ex.zh: 他們的婚姻很幸福。

marriage.en: the legal relationship between a husband and wife

ex.en: I'm surprised that you don't know about their marriage.
ex.zh: 我很驚訝你竟然不知道他們結婚了。

ex.en: Their marriage took place in a small church.
ex.zh: 他們在一間小教堂結婚。

marriage.en: the act or ceremony of becoming husband and wife

ex.en: The bat's diet consists mainly of insects and fruit.
ex.zh: 蝙蝠主要吃昆蟲和水果。

ex.en: That company deals mainly in imported goods.
ex.zh: 這家公司主要經營進口商品。

ex.en: Our customers are mainly young people.
ex.zh: 我們的顧客主要是年輕人。

mainly.en: in most cases, or for the most part

ex.en: George did business in the same manner as his father.
ex.zh: 喬治做生意的方式跟他父親一樣。

ex.en: I don't like his affected manner of speaking.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡他做作的說話方式。

manner.en: the way in which something is done

ex.en: I have trouble putting up with his rude manner.
ex.zh: 我受不了他那種無禮的態度。

ex.en: She has a friendly manner with customers.
ex.zh: 她對顧客態度親切。

manner.en: the way a person behaves or speaks toward others

ex.en: It is bad manners to point at people.
ex.zh: 用手指指人很沒禮貌。

ex.en: It's not good manners speaking during the meal.
ex.zh: 吃飯時講話不太禮貌。

manner.en: polite ways of behaving that people expect in a society

ex.en: English will take you a long time to master.
ex.zh: 你需要花很長的時間才能精通英語。

ex.en: A foreign language cannot be mastered in a year or so.
ex.zh: 一門外語不可能在一年左右就學好。

ex.en: Mastering a foreign language calls for patience.
ex.zh: 精通一門外語需要耐心。

master.en: to learn something so well that you can do it with great skill

ex.en: People should be the masters of their own destinies.
ex.zh: 每個人都應該做自己命運的主人。

ex.en: He is a master of Chinese calligraphy.
ex.zh: 他是書法大師。

master.en: a person who controls others, or a person who is expert at something

ex.en: She has a master's degree in finance.
ex.zh: 她有財務金融碩士學位。

ex.en: He's doing a master's in engineering.
ex.zh: 他正在攻讀工程碩士。

master.en: a university degree that you get after your first degree

master.zh: 主要的；原版的（master bedroom 主臥室）

ex.en: I keep the master copy under lock and key.
ex.zh: 我把母片鎖起來妥善保管。

ex.en: The master bedroom has its own bathroom.
ex.zh: 主臥室有獨立衛浴。

master.en: main or largest, or being the first copy from which others are made

ex.en: Please mail this form to your insurance company.
ex.zh: 請把這份表格寄給你的保險公司。

ex.en: Would you mind mailing this letter for me?
ex.zh: 可以幫我寄這封信嗎？

ex.en: Please remind me to mail the report tomorrow.
ex.zh: 請提醒我明天把報告寄出去。

mail.en: to send a letter or package by the postal service

ex.en: Has the mail arrived yet?
ex.zh: 郵件送來了嗎？

ex.en: I'll send the contract by mail.
ex.zh: 我會用郵寄的方式寄出合約。

mail.en: letters and packages that are sent and delivered, or the system that delivers them

ex.en: This truck has a maximum load of 5 tons.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車的最大載重量是五噸。

ex.en: The maximum speed on this road is 50 kilometers per hour.
ex.zh: 這條路的最高速限是時速 50 公里。

maximum.zh: 最大量、最大限度；最大值

ex.en: Note that the maximum doesn't always exist.
ex.zh: 注意，最大值不一定存在。

ex.en: The room holds a maximum of 30 people.
ex.zh: 這個房間最多可容納 30 人。

maximum.en: the largest amount or number that is possible

ex.en: Please contact the manufacturer for repairs.
ex.zh: 維修請聯絡製造商。

ex.en: The company is a leading manufacturer of electronic parts.
ex.zh: 這家公司是電子零件的主要製造商。

ex.en: Follow the manufacturer's instructions carefully.
ex.zh: 請仔細遵照製造商的使用說明。

manufacturer.en: a company that makes goods in large numbers

ex.en: This is the most massive structure I have ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我見過最龐大的建築物。

ex.en: Hey, look! Look! There's a massive rainbow!
ex.zh: 嘿，快看！有一道好大的彩虹！

ex.en: The company is facing massive losses this year.
ex.zh: 公司今年面臨巨額虧損。

ex.en: We had an examination in mathematics today.
ex.zh: 我們今天考了數學。

ex.en: I do not like mathematics very much.
ex.zh: 我不太喜歡數學。

ex.en: Maria asked me to help her in mathematics.
ex.zh: 瑪麗亞請我幫她學數學。

mathematics.en: the study of numbers, shapes and amounts

ex.en: He grew a beard to look more mature.
ex.zh: 他留鬍子，好讓自己看起來更成熟。

ex.en: She is very mature for her age.
ex.zh: 以她的年紀來說，她非常成熟。

mature.en: fully grown, or behaving in a sensible adult way

ex.en: Wine is put in barrels to mature.
ex.zh: 葡萄酒會放在木桶裡熟成。

ex.en: Children mature at different rates.
ex.zh: 每個孩子成熟的速度不同。

mature.en: to become fully grown, or to develop a full flavor over time

ex.en: The bond matures in five years.
ex.zh: 這張債券五年後到期。

ex.en: My insurance policy matures next year.
ex.zh: 我的保單明年到期。

mature.en: to reach the date when money must be paid out

mate.zh: 夥伴、同伴（常用於 classmate、roommate 等）

ex.en: I cannot understand my school mate's Cantonese.
ex.zh: 我聽不懂同學說的廣東話。

ex.en: I'm Paul, your room mate.
ex.zh: 我是保羅，你的室友。

ex.en: After my work mate quit his job he moved to Shanghai to teach English.
ex.zh: 我同事辭職後搬到上海教英文。

mate.en: a person who shares an activity, a place or a class with you

ex.en: I don't even know what you are called, mate.
ex.zh: 老兄，我連你叫什麼都不知道。

ex.en: Thanks for your help, mate!
ex.zh: 謝謝你的幫忙，兄弟！

mate.en: a friendly word used to speak to a man in British English

ex.en: During mating season many animals exude strong fragrances.
ex.zh: 很多動物在交配季節會散發強烈的氣味。

ex.en: Many birds mate for life.
ex.zh: 許多鳥類一生只有一個伴侶。

mate.en: to come together to produce young animals

ex.en: Write your notes in the margin.
ex.zh: 把筆記寫在頁邊空白處。

ex.en: Leave a wide margin on each side of the page.
ex.zh: 頁面兩側要留寬一點的邊。

margin.en: the empty space at the side of a written or printed page

ex.en: She won the election by a narrow margin.
ex.zh: 她以些微差距贏得選舉。

ex.en: We won the game by a margin of ten points.
ex.zh: 我們以十分之差贏得比賽。

margin.en: the amount by which one side wins or is ahead of another

ex.en: Our profit margins are getting smaller.
ex.zh: 我們的利潤率越來越低。

ex.en: The store sells its goods at a low margin.
ex.zh: 這家店以低毛利銷售商品。

margin.en: the difference between what something costs and what it sells for

ex.en: I didn't think that Tom would be so mad.
ex.zh: 我沒有想到湯姆會那麼生氣。

ex.en: Please don't get mad, sir! I'm a new worker!
ex.zh: 先生，請別生氣！我是新來的員工！

ex.en: He got mad at me for calling him Shorty.
ex.zh: 我叫他「矮子」，他氣得要命。

ex.en: For a moment there, I thought he had gone mad.
ex.zh: 那一瞬間，我還以為他瘋了。

ex.en: He went mad when he heard the story.
ex.zh: 他聽到那件事後簡直要瘋了。

mad.en: having a serious mental illness, or acting in a very foolish way

ex.en: My son is mad about soccer.
ex.zh: 我兒子超迷足球。

ex.en: She's mad about Korean dramas.
ex.zh: 她非常著迷韓劇。

mad.en: to like something or someone very much

ex.en: March 15 will be my last day of school.
ex.zh: 3 月 15 日將是我最後一天上學。

ex.en: All the flights on March 30th were fully booked.
ex.zh: 3 月 30 日的班機全部客滿。

march.en: the third month of the year

ex.en: A brass band is marching along the street.
ex.zh: 一支銅管樂隊沿著街道行進。

ex.en: The band marched in the parade.
ex.zh: 樂隊在遊行隊伍中行進。

march.en: to walk with regular steps in a group, often to protest

ex.en: We joined a charity march last weekend.
ex.zh: 我們上週末參加了一場慈善健走遊行。

ex.en: The soldiers were tired after the long march.
ex.zh: 士兵們長途行軍後很疲累。

march.en: a walk by a group of people to show their views, or a long walk by soldiers

ex.en: Sami tried some easy magic tricks.
ex.zh: 薩米試著變了幾個簡單的魔術。

ex.en: The girl vanished like magic.
ex.zh: 那個女孩像變魔術一樣消失了。

ex.en: The kids loved the magic show.
ex.zh: 孩子們很喜歡那場魔術表演。

magic.en: clever tricks that seem impossible, or a mysterious power to make strange things happen

ex.en: My parents say that YouTube and streaming services cheapen the magic of film.
ex.zh: 我爸媽說 YouTube 和串流平台讓電影失去了魔力。

ex.en: The magic of Paris attracts millions of visitors.
ex.zh: 巴黎的魅力吸引了數百萬遊客。

magic.en: a special quality that makes something wonderful and exciting

ex.en: There's no magic solution to this problem.
ex.zh: 這個問題沒有神奇的解決辦法。

ex.en: Please is a magic word for kids.
ex.zh: 對小孩來說，「請」是個神奇的字。

magic.en: having strange powers that seem to work like a wonder

ex.en: Toyota is a major car maker.
ex.zh: 豐田是一家大型汽車製造商。

ex.en: The maker recalled the faulty phones.
ex.zh: 製造商回收了那批有問題的手機。

maker.en: a company or person that produces something

ex.en: Grease the waffle maker.
ex.zh: 在鬆餅機上抹油。

ex.en: I bought a new coffee maker for the office.
ex.zh: 我幫辦公室買了一台新的咖啡機。

maker.en: a person who makes something, or a machine that makes a certain thing

ex.en: He is one of the candidates running for mayor.
ex.zh: 他是市長候選人之一。

ex.en: He was elected mayor of the city.
ex.zh: 他當選了市長。

ex.en: He is going to run for mayor.
ex.zh: 他將參選市長。

mayor.en: the person who is the elected head of a town or city

ex.en: He showed me the manuscript of his new play.
ex.zh: 他給我看了他新劇本的手稿。

ex.en: The author sent her manuscript to three publishers.
ex.zh: 作者把她的稿子寄給三家出版社。

ex.en: Please check the manuscript for errors before printing.
ex.zh: 印刷前請檢查原稿有沒有錯誤。

manuscript.en: a handwritten or typed text of a book or document before it is printed

ex.en: Thousands of laborers and craftsmen toiled for 22 years to craft the stunning white marble edifice.
ex.zh: 數千名工人與工匠辛苦工作了 22 年，才打造出這座令人驚嘆的白色大理石建築。

ex.en: The hotel lobby has a marble floor.
ex.zh: 飯店大廳鋪著大理石地板。

marble.en: a hard smooth stone used for buildings and statues

ex.en: The kids were playing marbles in the yard.
ex.zh: 孩子們在院子裡玩彈珠。

ex.en: He keeps his marbles in a glass jar.
ex.zh: 他把彈珠放在玻璃罐裡。

marble.en: a small glass ball used in children's games

ex.en: Write your name with a marker.
ex.zh: 用麥克筆寫上你的名字。

ex.en: Please use a whiteboard marker, not a pen.
ex.zh: 請用白板筆，不要用原子筆。

marker.en: a thick pen used for writing or drawing in bold lines

ex.en: A stone marker shows where the old gate stood.
ex.zh: 一塊石碑標示出舊城門的位置。

ex.en: Blood pressure is an important marker of health.
ex.zh: 血壓是重要的健康指標。

marker.en: an object or sign that shows a place or position

ex.en: He received a bone marrow transplant.
ex.zh: 他接受了骨髓移植。

ex.en: She signed up to be a bone marrow donor.
ex.zh: 她登記成為骨髓捐贈者。

ex.en: Maternal love is greater than anything else.
ex.zh: 母愛比什麼都偉大。

ex.en: She has strong maternal instincts.
ex.zh: 她有很強的母性本能。

maternal.en: having to do with a mother, or typical of a mother

maternal.zh: 母系的、母方的（外公、外婆等）

ex.en: My mother's father is my maternal grandfather.
ex.zh: 我媽媽的爸爸是我的外公。

ex.en: My maternal grandmother lives in Tainan.
ex.zh: 我外婆住在台南。

maternal.en: related to you through your mother

ex.en: He is the manager of the marketing department.
ex.zh: 他是行銷部的主管。

ex.en: I'm in marketing.
ex.zh: 我在行銷部門工作。

ex.en: The objectives of the marketing department and the sales department are not necessarily the same.
ex.zh: 行銷部和業務部的目標不見得一樣。

marketing.en: the work of advertising and selling products

ex.en: Entering the house, I tripped over the mat.
ex.zh: 我一進家門就被地墊絆倒了。

ex.en: The dog was sleeping on the mat.
ex.zh: 狗在墊子上睡覺。

ex.en: I found the key underneath the mat.
ex.zh: 我在門口地墊下面找到了鑰匙。

mat.en: a small piece of material on the floor, such as one by a door for cleaning shoes

ex.en: Bring your own yoga mat to the class.
ex.zh: 上課請自備瑜伽墊。

ex.en: She put a mat under the hot pot.
ex.zh: 她在熱鍋下面墊了一塊墊子。

mat.en: a flat piece of material for exercise, or one put under plates or cups

ex.en: Is this a stallion or a mare?
ex.zh: 這是公馬還是母馬？

ex.en: The mare gave birth to a healthy foal.
ex.zh: 母馬生下一匹健康的小馬。

ex.en: The farmer keeps two mares and a stallion.
ex.zh: 農夫養了兩匹母馬和一匹公馬。

ex.en: He asked her to marry him, and she accepted.
ex.zh: 他向她求婚，她答應了。

ex.en: It is already ten years since we got married.
ex.zh: 我們結婚已經有十年了。

ex.en: Mariko's parents are strongly opposed to her marrying an American.
ex.zh: 麻理子的父母強烈反對她和美國人結婚。

marry.en: to become the husband or wife of someone

ex.en: There are big markdowns on winter coats this week.
ex.zh: 這週冬季外套大降價。

ex.en: The store announced a 30% markdown on all shoes.
ex.zh: 這家店宣布所有鞋子降價三成。

markdown.en: a lowering of the price of something

ex.en: For the main course, I'll have the steak.
ex.zh: 主菜我要牛排。

ex.en: The main course was served with rice and vegetables.
ex.zh: 主菜附米飯和蔬菜。

main course.en: the biggest part of a meal, eaten after the first dish

ex.en: We watched the tennis match on TV.
ex.zh: 我們在電視上看網球比賽。

ex.en: Our team won the match 3 to 1.
ex.zh: 我們隊以三比一贏了比賽。

match.en: a sports game between two people or teams

ex.en: Ben learned to make a fire without matches.
ex.zh: 班學會了不用火柴生火。

ex.en: Do you have a match? I need to light the candle.
ex.zh: 你有火柴嗎？我要點蠟燭。

match.en: a small stick that makes fire when you rub it on a rough surface

ex.en: Mr. and Mrs. Smith are a good match.
ex.zh: 史密斯夫婦是很登對的一對。

ex.en: He is a good match for me in tennis.
ex.zh: 打網球的話，他和我勢均力敵。

match.en: a person or thing that goes well with another, or an equal opponent

ex.en: The restaurant can't be matched for good service.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的服務無人能比。

ex.en: Your shoes don't match your dress.
ex.zh: 你的鞋子跟洋裝不搭。

match.en: to go well with something, or to be as good as something else

ex.en: We are planning changes to the manufacturing process.
ex.zh: 我們算計著改革生產流程。

ex.en: Manufacturing is the main industry in this region.
ex.zh: 製造業是這個地區的主要產業。

ex.en: She works in manufacturing, making car parts.
ex.zh: 她在製造業工作，生產汽車零件。

manufacturing.en: the business of making goods in large numbers with machines

marvel.zh: 令人驚奇的事物或人物

ex.en: The medicine worked marvels.
ex.zh: 這藥創造了奇蹟。

ex.en: The new bridge is a marvel of modern engineering.
ex.zh: 這座新橋是現代工程的奇蹟。

marvel.en: a person or thing that is wonderful and surprising

ex.en: Visitors marvel at the beauty of the old temple.
ex.zh: 遊客對古老廟宇的美讚嘆不已。

ex.en: We marveled at how fast the child learned to read.
ex.zh: 我們對那孩子學會閱讀的速度之快感到驚奇。

marvel.en: to feel or show great surprise and admiration

ex.en: It is really marvelous of you to remember my birthday.
ex.zh: 你還記得我的生日，那真是太好了。

ex.en: What a marvelous person your brother is!
ex.zh: 你的弟弟真是個奇妙的人。

ex.en: We had a marvelous time at the festival.
ex.zh: 我們在慶典上玩得非常開心。

ex.en: The ceremony marked the boys' passage into manhood.
ex.zh: 這個儀式標誌著男孩們邁入成年。

ex.en: He felt his manhood was being challenged.
ex.zh: 他覺得自己的男子氣概受到了挑戰。

manhood.en: the state of being an adult man, or the qualities seen as typical of men

ex.en: Nothing will hinder my malicious plan.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼能阻礙我邪惡的計劃。

ex.en: She spread malicious gossip about her coworkers.
ex.zh: 她散播關於同事的惡意流言。

ex.en: The fire was the result of a malicious act.
ex.zh: 這場火災是惡意縱火的結果。

malicious.en: meant to hurt or upset other people

ex.en: Malaria is carried by mosquitoes.
ex.zh: 瘧疾是由蚊子傳染的。

ex.en: They're suffering from malaria.
ex.zh: 他們罹患了瘧疾。

ex.en: Take malaria pills before you travel to that region.
ex.zh: 去那個地區旅行前要先吃預防瘧疾的藥。

malaria.en: a serious disease spread by insects that bite, causing fever

ex.en: Can you tell me about your marital status?
ex.zh: 能告訴我你的婚姻狀況嗎？

ex.en: They went to counseling to work through their marital problems.
ex.zh: 他們去接受諮商，想解決婚姻問題。

ex.en: It is already ten years since we got married.
ex.zh: 我們結婚已經有十年了。

ex.en: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.
ex.zh: 雖然他們已經結婚了，卻還是分房睡。

ex.en: Why didn't you tell Tom that you were married?
ex.zh: 你為什麼不告訴湯姆你已經結婚了？

ex.en: I wish you a long and happy married life.
ex.zh: 祝你們婚姻長長久久、永浴愛河。

ex.en: Married life taught them how to share chores and make decisions together.
ex.zh: 婚姻生活讓他們學會分擔家事、一起做決定。

married.en: related to life together as husband and wife

ex.en: It is bad manners to point at people.
ex.zh: 用手指著別人很不禮貌。

ex.en: It is bad manners to make a noise while you eat.
ex.zh: 吃飯時發出聲音是不禮貌的。

ex.en: He has no manners at all.
ex.zh: 他一點禮貌也沒有。

manners.en: polite ways of behaving that people expect in a society

ex.en: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.
ex.zh: 核戰爭將會為人類帶來滅亡。

ex.en: Language is one of the most important inventions of mankind.
ex.zh: 語言是人類最重大的發明之一。

ex.en: No one man can answer what's the meaning of life; this question stands before all mankind.
ex.zh: 沒有一個人能回答出生命的意義是什麼；這個問題就擺在全人類面前。

mankind.en: all the people in the world

ex.en: The road to mastery is oh so long.
ex.zh: 通往精通的路真是漫長啊。

ex.en: Her mastery of three languages helped her get the job.
ex.zh: 她精通三種語言，因此得到了這份工作。

ex.en: Mastery of any skill takes years of practice.
ex.zh: 要精通任何技能都需要多年的練習。

mastery.en: great skill or full knowledge of something

ex.en: Confidence and courage are not just masculine traits; they are values anyone can strive for.
ex.zh: 自信與勇氣不只是男性的特質，而是任何人都能追求的價值。

ex.en: He has a deep, masculine voice.
ex.zh: 他的聲音低沉，很有男人味。

ex.en: Some people think cooking isn't masculine, but that's old-fashioned.
ex.zh: 有些人認為下廚不夠男子氣概，但這種想法很過時。

masculine.en: having qualities that are thought to be typical of men

ex.en: This really is a masterpiece.
ex.zh: 這真是個傑作。

ex.en: “The Satanic Verses” by Salman Rushdie is a real masterpiece of modern literature.
ex.zh: 魯西迪的《魔鬼詩篇》是現代文學的傑作。

ex.en: He was surprised to find the great artist's masterpiece hung on the wall upside down.
ex.zh: 他驚訝地發現，那位大畫家的傑作竟然被倒掛在牆上。

masterpiece.en: a work of art or writing of very high quality

ex.en: An old worker was found repairing machinery in the workshop.
ex.zh: 有人看到一位老工人在車間裡修理機器。

ex.en: Something must be wrong with the machinery.
ex.zh: 機器一定是哪裡出了問題。

ex.en: Then arose the question of where we were to get the necessary machinery.
ex.zh: 接著問題來了：我們要去哪裡弄到需要的機器？

machinery.en: machines as a group, or the moving parts of a machine

ex.en: This company manufactures computer chips.
ex.zh: 這家公司生產電腦晶片。

ex.en: This factory manufactures automobile parts.
ex.zh: 這家工廠生產汽車零件。

ex.en: These cameras are manufactured in Japan.
ex.zh: 這些相機是在日本製造的。

manufacture.en: to make goods in large numbers using machines

ex.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
ex.zh: 製造日期印在蓋子上。

ex.en: We are planning changes to the manufacturing process.
ex.zh: 我們打算改變製造流程。

manufacture.en: the process of making goods in large numbers

ex.en: We bought some vegetables and fish at the market.
ex.zh: 我們在市場買了一些菜和魚。

ex.en: Can you tell me where the flea market is?
ex.zh: 你能告訴我跳蚤市場在哪裡嗎？

market.en: a place where people buy and sell goods, often outdoors

ex.en: The company wants to enter the Japanese market.
ex.zh: 這家公司想打進日本市場。

ex.en: There is a big market for electric cars.
ex.zh: 電動車有很大的市場。

market.en: the people who might buy a product, or the business of buying and selling it

ex.en: The product is marketed to young people.
ex.zh: 這項產品主打年輕族群。

ex.en: They market their tea online.
ex.zh: 他們在網路上行銷自家的茶。

market.en: to advertise and sell a product

ex.en: The company increased its market share to 30%.
ex.zh: 這家公司把市占率提高到 30%。

ex.en: We are losing market share to cheaper brands.
ex.zh: 我們的市占率正被更便宜的品牌搶走。

market share.en: the part of all sales in an area of business that one company has

ex.en: That isn't mandatory.
ex.zh: 那不是強制的。

ex.en: A cooking course should be mandatory in schools.
ex.zh: 烹飪課應該成為學校的必修課。

ex.en: Wearing a helmet is mandatory on construction sites.
ex.zh: 在工地戴安全帽是強制規定。

mandatory.en: required by a rule or law

ex.en: The elevator is closed for maintenance.
ex.zh: 電梯維修中，暫停使用。

ex.en: Regular maintenance keeps your car running well.
ex.zh: 定期保養能讓你的車保持良好狀態。

maintenance.en: the work of keeping a building or machine in good condition

ex.en: The repair for the system malfunction lasted for an entire night.
ex.zh: 系統故障的修復工作持續了一整夜。

ex.en: A malfunction in the engine caused the delay.
ex.zh: 引擎故障導致延誤。

malfunction.en: a failure of a machine or system to work correctly

ex.en: This clock seems to be malfunctioning.
ex.zh: 這個時鐘好像故障了。

ex.en: The alarm malfunctioned and went off at midnight.
ex.zh: 警報器故障，半夜響了起來。

ex.en: The package is waiting in the mailroom.
ex.zh: 包裹正在郵件收發室等候領取。

ex.en: Mailroom staff sort incoming letters each morning.
ex.zh: 郵件收發室人員每天早上分類收到的信件。

mailroom.en: a room in an office where letters and packages are sorted and sent out

ex.en: The signed agreement is in your mailbox.
ex.zh: 已簽署的協議在您的信箱裡。

ex.en: Please check the mailbox for the client letter.
ex.zh: 請查看信箱裡的客戶來信。

mailbox.en: a box where letters are delivered, or a place where email messages are stored

ex.en: She will begin maternity leave in September.
ex.zh: 她將於九月開始休產假。

ex.en: The company offers paid maternity leave.
ex.zh: 公司提供有薪產假。

maternity leave.en: time off work that a woman takes before and after having a baby

ex.en: The warehouse needs extra manpower during the holiday rush.
ex.zh: 假期旺季期間，倉庫需要增加人力。

ex.en: A shortage of trained manpower delayed the equipment installation.
ex.zh: 熟練人力不足，導致設備安裝延後。

manpower.en: the number of people available to do a job

market penetration.zh: 市場滲透；市場占有率拓展

ex.en: A local distributor helped the brand increase its market penetration in central Taiwan.
ex.zh: 當地經銷商協助這個品牌拓展在台灣中部的市場滲透率。

ex.en: The report compares the product’s market penetration across three age groups.
ex.zh: 這份報告比較該產品在三個年齡層中的市場滲透情況。

market penetration.en: the share of possible buyers that a product has reached

markup.zh: 加價幅度；（售價高於成本的）加價

ex.en: The retailer added a 15% markup to the wholesale price.
ex.zh: 零售商在批發價上加了 15% 作為加價。

ex.en: A high markup may discourage budget-conscious buyers.
ex.zh: 加價幅度太高，可能會讓重視預算的買家卻步。

markup.en: the amount added to the cost of goods to get the selling price

ex.en: The customs officer reviewed the cargo manifest.
ex.zh: 海關人員檢查了貨物清單。

ex.en: Each package must appear on the shipping manifest.
ex.zh: 每個包裹都必須列在運送清單上。

manifest.en: an official list of the goods or passengers on a ship or plane

ex.en: The port follows strict maritime safety rules.
ex.zh: 這座港口遵守嚴格的海事安全規範。

ex.en: Maritime transport carries most of the company's exports.
ex.zh: 公司的大部分出口貨物都由海運承載。

maritime.en: related to the sea or to ships

ex.en: The historic mansion now operates as a public museum.
ex.zh: 這座歷史豪宅現在作為公立博物館使用。

ex.en: The developer converted the mansion into a boutique hotel.
ex.zh: 開發商將這棟大宅邸改建成精品旅館。

mansion.en: a very large and impressive house

ex.en: The new collection is displayed on mannequins by the entrance.
ex.zh: 入口旁的人體模型展示了新系列服裝。

ex.en: A mannequin in the window wears the store"s latest coat.
ex.zh: 櫥窗裡的服裝模特兒穿著店內最新款的大衣。

mannequin.en: a model of a human body used to show clothes in a shop

ex.en: This is a map of the city of Sendai.
ex.zh: 這是一張仙台市的地圖。

ex.en: A map helps us to know where we are.
ex.zh: 地圖幫助我們知道所在的位置。

ex.en: Can you give me a map of the street?
ex.zh: 請給我一張街道地圖好嗎？

map.en: a drawing of an area that shows places such as roads, towns and rivers

ex.en: He is the manager of the marketing department.
ex.zh: 他是行銷部的經理。

ex.en: Dad said he'd be promoted to section manager next year.
ex.zh: 爸爸說他明年會升為課長。

ex.en: I have to introduce Mary to the manager.
ex.zh: 我得把瑪麗介紹給經理認識。

manager.en: a person who is in charge of a business, a team or a part of a company

ex.en: The magistrate fined him for driving too fast.
ex.zh: 法官因他超速而對他罰款。

ex.en: She was appointed as a magistrate last year.
ex.zh: 她去年被任命為地方法官。

ex.en: My favourite subject at school was math.
ex.zh: 我在學校最喜歡的科目是數學。

ex.en: She helps her little brother with his math homework.
ex.zh: 她幫弟弟寫數學作業。

ex.en: You need good math skills to be an engineer.
ex.zh: 要當工程師需要有好的數學能力。

ex.en: She spends twenty minutes putting on makeup every morning.
ex.zh: 她每天早上花二十分鐘化妝。

ex.en: Please remove your makeup before you go to bed.
ex.zh: 睡前請先卸妝。

ex.en: The team's makeup changed a lot after the new players joined.
ex.zh: 新球員加入後，球隊的組成改變很多。

ex.en: Honesty is part of his basic makeup.
ex.zh: 誠實是他天性的一部分。

ex.en: There has been a marked improvement in his English.
ex.zh: 他的英文有了明顯的進步。

ex.en: The two cities show a marked difference in weather.
ex.zh: 這兩個城市的天氣有顯著的差異。

ex.en: Please use the marked exit in case of fire.
ex.zh: 發生火災時請使用有標示的出口。

ex.en: The marked boxes are ready to be shipped.
ex.zh: 有做記號的箱子已準備好可以出貨。

ex.en: We enjoyed a magnificent view of the mountains.
ex.zh: 我們欣賞了壯麗的山景。

ex.en: The king lived in a magnificent palace.
ex.zh: 國王住在宏偉的宮殿裡。

ex.en: She gave a magnificent performance on stage.
ex.zh: 她在舞台上有出色的表演。

ex.en: The chef prepared a magnificent meal for us.
ex.zh: 主廚為我們準備了一頓極棒的餐點。

ex.en: She studies marine life along the coast of Taiwan.
ex.zh: 她研究台灣沿岸的海洋生物。

ex.en: The marine park protects many kinds of colorful fish.
ex.zh: 這座海洋公園保護了許多種色彩繽紛的魚。

ex.en: His brother joined the marines after finishing high school.
ex.zh: 他哥哥高中畢業後加入了海軍陸戰隊。

ex.en: The marine stood guard at the gate all night.
ex.zh: 那位海軍陸戰隊員整晚在大門站崗。

ex.en: We had a marvellous time at the beach.
ex.zh: 我們在海邊玩得非常開心。

ex.en: What a marvellous idea; let's do it!
ex.zh: 真是個絕妙的點子，我們就這麼做吧！

ex.en: They stayed at an old manor in the English countryside.
ex.zh: 他們住在英國鄉間的一座老莊園。

ex.en: The manor is surrounded by a large garden.
ex.zh: 這座莊園被一座大花園圍繞著。

ex.en: The making of this cake takes about two hours.
ex.zh: 製作這個蛋糕大約要兩個小時。

ex.en: She learned the art of cheese making from her uncle.
ex.zh: 她跟叔叔學會了做乳酪的技藝。

ex.en: This experience was the making of him.
ex.zh: 這次經歷造就了他。

ex.en: She has all the makings of a good leader.
ex.zh: 她具備成為好領導者的所有條件。

ex.en: Mary is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 瑪麗是英語系國家很常見的名字。

ex.en: Mary takes piano lessons every Tuesday.
ex.zh: 瑪麗每個星期二都去上鋼琴課。

ex.en: I shared my umbrella with Mary on the way home.
ex.zh: 回家的路上我和瑪麗共撐一把傘。

ex.en: Martin is a common given name in many European countries.
ex.zh: 馬丁是許多歐洲國家很常見的名字。

ex.en: Martin lives next door and often waters our plants.
ex.zh: 馬丁住在隔壁，常常幫我們澆花。

ex.en: A martin built its nest under the roof of our house.
ex.zh: 一隻燕子在我們家屋簷下築了巢。

ex.en: We watched a martin catch insects in the evening sky.
ex.zh: 我們看著一隻燕子在傍晚的天空中捕捉昆蟲。

ex.en: Manchester is a large city in the north of England.
ex.zh: 曼徹斯特是英格蘭北部的一座大城市。

ex.en: Her cousin studies at a university in Manchester.
ex.zh: 她的表哥在曼徹斯特的一所大學讀書。

ex.en: Margaret is a traditional name for girls in English.
ex.zh: 瑪格麗特是英語中傳統的女孩名字。

ex.en: Margaret grows tomatoes and herbs in her small garden.
ex.zh: 瑪格麗特在她的小花園裡種番茄和香草。

ex.en: Maggie bakes fresh bread every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 瑪姬每週六早上都會烤新鮮的麵包。

ex.en: I sat beside Maggie during the long meeting.
ex.zh: 開那場冗長的會議時，我坐在瑪姬旁邊。

ex.en: Matthew is the first book of the New Testament.
ex.zh: 馬太福音是新約聖經的第一卷書。

ex.en: The pastor read a short passage from Matthew on Sunday.
ex.zh: 牧師週日朗讀了馬太福音中的一小段。

managing.zh: 管理、經營（manage 的現在分詞）

ex.en: She is managing a team of ten people.
ex.zh: 她正在管理一個十人的團隊。

ex.en: He spends most of his time managing the restaurant.
ex.zh: 他大部分時間都在經營那間餐廳。

ex.en: He was promoted to managing director last year.
ex.zh: 他去年被升為總經理。

ex.en: The managing editor reviews every article before it is published.
ex.zh: 主編會在每篇文章刊出前審閱。

ex.en: Maria cooks delicious dinners for her friends.
ex.zh: 瑪麗亞為朋友們煮了美味的晚餐。

ex.en: I asked Maria to translate the letter for me.
ex.zh: 我請瑪麗亞幫我翻譯這封信。

ex.en: Karl Marx was a German philosopher who wrote about economics and society.
ex.zh: 卡爾·馬克思是德國哲學家，著有探討經濟與社會的作品。

ex.en: We read a short passage by Marx in our history class.
ex.zh: 我們在歷史課上讀了一小段馬克思的文章。

ex.en: Malcolm is a name that comes from Scotland.
ex.zh: 馬爾科姆這個名字源自蘇格蘭。

ex.en: In the story, a boy named Malcolm finds a map.
ex.zh: 故事裡，一個叫馬爾科姆的男孩找到了一張地圖。

ex.en: Marie is a French form of the name Mary.
ex.zh: 瑪麗是 Mary 這個名字的法文形式。

ex.en: Marie Curie was a scientist who won two Nobel Prizes.
ex.zh: 瑪麗·居禮是科學家，曾獲得兩次諾貝爾獎。

ex.en: Marshall is both a surname and a first name.
ex.zh: 馬歇爾既是姓氏，也可以當作名字。

ex.en: The name Marshall once meant a person who looked after horses.
ex.zh: 馬歇爾這個名字原本指的是照顧馬匹的人。

ex.en: The max speed on this road is fifty kilometers an hour.
ex.zh: 這條路的最高時速是五十公里。

ex.en: This elevator can hold ten people at the max.
ex.zh: 這部電梯最多能載十個人。

ex.en: Max is a short form of Maximilian.
ex.zh: 麥克斯是馬克西米利安的簡稱。

ex.en: My neighbor named his dog Max.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居把他的狗取名叫麥克斯。

ex.en: Marijuana is legal in some places but illegal in others.
ex.zh: 大麻在有些地方合法，在其他地方卻是違法的。

ex.en: Doctors are still studying how marijuana affects the brain.
ex.zh: 醫生仍在研究大麻如何影響大腦。

maid.zh: 女傭、女僕、客房清潔人員

ex.en: The maid cleaned all the rooms before noon.
ex.zh: 客房清潔人員在中午前打掃完了所有房間。

ex.en: In the old house, a maid brought tea to the guests.
ex.zh: 在那棟老房子裡，一位女僕為客人端上了茶。

ex.en: The hotel maid left fresh towels on the bed.
ex.zh: 飯店的清潔人員在床上放了乾淨的毛巾。

ex.en: He wrote a paper on Marxist ideas about work.
ex.zh: 他寫了一篇關於馬克思主義勞動思想的論文。

ex.en: The professor teaches a course on Marxist theory.
ex.zh: 那位教授開了一門馬克思主義理論的課。

ex.en: The writer described himself as a Marxist.
ex.zh: 那位作家形容自己是馬克思主義者。

ex.en: The loud music was masking the noise from the street.
ex.zh: 大聲的音樂蓋過了街上的噪音。

ex.en: He drove like a madman through the narrow streets.
ex.zh: 他像瘋子一樣在狹窄的街道上飆車。

ex.en: In the movie, the madman builds a strange machine.
ex.zh: 電影裡，那個瘋子打造了一台奇怪的機器。

ex.en: The train left the branch and joined the mainline.
ex.zh: 火車離開支線，駛上了幹線。

ex.en: The town sits on the mainline between two big cities.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮位在兩個大城市之間的鐵路幹線上。

manipulative.zh: 愛操控別人的；工於心計的

ex.en: He was manipulative and often lied to get his way.
ex.zh: 他很會操控別人，常為了達到目的而說謊。

ex.en: She realized her friend's manipulative behavior was hurting her.
ex.zh: 她發現朋友愛操控人的行為正在傷害她。

ex.en: The surgeon needs excellent manipulative skills.
ex.zh: 外科醫師需要極佳的手部操作技巧。

ex.en: Young children develop manipulative abilities by playing with blocks.
ex.zh: 幼兒透過玩積木培養手部操作能力。

ex.en: The team's mascot danced on the field.
ex.zh: 球隊的吉祥物在場上跳舞。

ex.en: Every school event has a cute bear as its mascot.
ex.zh: 學校每場活動都有一隻可愛的熊當吉祥物。

ex.en: He has a deep, manly voice.
ex.zh: 他有一把低沉有男子氣概的嗓音。

ex.en: Crying doesn't make you any less manly.
ex.zh: 哭泣並不會讓你少一點男子氣概。

manned.zh: 有人駕駛的、有人操作的

ex.en: The first manned flight to the moon amazed the world.
ex.zh: 第一次載人登月飛行讓全世界驚嘆。

ex.en: The gate is manned twenty-four hours a day.
ex.zh: 這個入口二十四小時都有人看守。

ex.en: The rule is manifestly unfair to new students.
ex.zh: 這條規定對新生明顯不公平。

ex.en: He was manifestly unprepared for the interview.
ex.zh: 他顯然沒有為面試做好準備。

ex.en: The mayoral election will be held next month.
ex.zh: 市長選舉將在下個月舉行。

ex.en: She is running in the mayoral race.
ex.zh: 她參加了市長競選。

ex.en: The school uniform includes a maroon sweater.
ex.zh: 這所學校的制服包括一件褐紫紅色的毛衣。

ex.en: She painted the door a deep maroon color.
ex.zh: 她把門漆成深褐紫紅色。

ex.en: Maroon is my favorite color for winter coats.
ex.zh: 褐紫紅色是我冬季外套最喜歡的顏色。

ex.en: The walls were painted in a rich maroon.
ex.zh: 牆壁漆成了濃郁的褐紫紅色。

maroon.zh: 使被困孤島；使孤立無援

ex.en: The storm marooned the hikers on a small island.
ex.zh: 暴風雨讓健行者被困在一座小島上。

ex.en: The travelers were marooned in the village for three days by the snow.
ex.zh: 旅客因大雪被困在村裡三天。

ex.en: The saint's martyrdom is remembered every year in the town.
ex.zh: 小鎮每年都紀念那位聖人的殉道。

ex.en: He accepted martyrdom rather than give up his beliefs.
ex.zh: 他寧願殉道也不放棄信仰。

ex.en: The children played marvellously together all afternoon.
ex.zh: 孩子們整個下午玩得非常融洽愉快。

ex.en: The old clock still works marvellously after fifty years.
ex.zh: 那座老時鐘用了五十年還是運作得好極了。

ex.en: The young mage cast a spell to light the cave.
ex.zh: 年輕的魔法師施了個咒語照亮山洞。

ex.en: In the game, the mage stays at the back and uses magic.
ex.zh: 在遊戲裡，魔法師待在後方使用魔法。

ex.en: He has an odd mannerism of tapping his chin when he thinks.
ex.zh: 他有個怪習慣，思考時會輕敲自己的下巴。

ex.en: The comedian copied the teacher's mannerisms perfectly.
ex.zh: 那位喜劇演員把老師的習慣動作模仿得惟妙惟肖。

ex.en: He felt a general malaise and stayed in bed.
ex.zh: 他渾身不舒服，就待在床上休息。

ex.en: A sense of malaise spread through the company.
ex.zh: 一種不安的氣氛在公司裡蔓延開來。

ex.en: The driver behaved like a maniac on the road.
ex.zh: 那位駕駛在路上開得像瘋子一樣。

ex.en: He's a football maniac who never misses a game.
ex.zh: 他是個足球狂，一場比賽都不會錯過。

ex.en: He let out a maniac laugh in the dark.
ex.zh: 他在黑暗中發出一陣瘋狂的笑聲。

ex.en: The maniac energy of the crowd filled the stadium.
ex.zh: 群眾瘋狂的熱情充滿了整個體育場。

ex.en: The pianist gave a masterful performance last night.
ex.zh: 那位鋼琴家昨晚的演出精湛絕倫。

ex.en: She made a masterful speech that moved the whole audience.
ex.zh: 她發表了一場高明的演說，感動了全場觀眾。

ex.en: He spoke in a masterful tone and expected everyone to obey.
ex.zh: 他以強勢的口吻說話，期待大家都服從。

ex.en: The new manager has a rather masterful manner.
ex.zh: 新經理的態度相當強勢。

manicured.zh: 修剪整齊的；精心修整的

ex.en: The hotel has beautifully manicured gardens.
ex.zh: 這間旅館有修剪得很漂亮的花園。

ex.en: He walked across the manicured lawn to the front door.
ex.zh: 他穿過修剪整齊的草坪走向前門。

ex.en: The kids roasted marshmallows over the campfire.
ex.zh: 孩子們在營火上烤棉花糖。

ex.en: She put a marshmallow in her hot chocolate.
ex.zh: 她在熱可可裡放了一顆棉花糖。

ex.en: Marseilles is a busy port city in the south of France.
ex.zh: 馬賽是法國南部一座繁忙的港口城市。

ex.en: They took a train from Paris to Marseilles last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天他們搭火車從巴黎到馬賽。

ex.en: Police are searching for the mastermind of the robbery.
ex.zh: 警方正在追查這起搶案的幕後主謀。

ex.en: She was the mastermind behind the company's success.
ex.zh: 她是公司成功背後的策劃者。

ex.en: He helped mastermind the whole event.
ex.zh: 他協助策劃了整個活動。

ex.en: Who masterminded the plan to save the school?
ex.zh: 是誰策劃了拯救學校的計畫？

mayfair.zh: 梅費爾（倫敦的高級地段）

ex.en: Mayfair is a wealthy area in central London.
ex.zh: 梅費爾是倫敦市中心的高級地段。

ex.en: The hotel in Mayfair is popular with tourists.
ex.zh: 那間位於梅費爾的飯店很受觀光客歡迎。

ex.en: She painted the bedroom walls a soft mauve.
ex.zh: 她把臥室的牆壁漆成柔和的淡紫色。

ex.en: The sky turned from orange to mauve as the sun set.
ex.zh: 太陽下山時，天空從橘色轉成淡紫色。

ex.en: She wore a mauve scarf to the party.
ex.zh: 她戴著一條淡紫色的圍巾去參加派對。

ex.en: The garden was full of mauve flowers in spring.
ex.zh: 春天時花園裡開滿淡紫色的花。

ex.en: The result is mathematically correct but hard to explain.
ex.zh: 這個結果在數學上是正確的，但很難解釋。

ex.en: She is mathematically gifted and loves solving puzzles.
ex.zh: 她在數學方面很有天賦，喜歡解謎題。

ex.en: Fish and crabs live among the roots of the mangrove.
ex.zh: 魚和螃蟹棲息在紅樹林的根間。

ex.en: Mangrove forests protect the coast from strong waves.
ex.zh: 紅樹林保護海岸不受大浪侵襲。

ex.en: We had grilled mackerel with rice for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐吃了烤鯖魚配飯。

ex.en: Mackerel is rich in healthy oils and fairly cheap.
ex.zh: 鯖魚富含健康的油脂，而且價格不貴。

ex.en: The doctor could not name the strange malady.
ex.zh: 醫生說不出這種怪病的名稱。

ex.en: Corruption is a malady that harms the whole society.
ex.zh: 貪腐是一種危害整個社會的弊病。

macabre.zh: 陰森可怕的；與死亡相關的

ex.en: The writer is known for his macabre short stories.
ex.zh: 這位作家以陰森詭異的短篇小說聞名。

ex.en: The old house had a macabre atmosphere at night.
ex.zh: 那棟老房子在夜裡有種陰森可怕的氣氛。

ex.en: The maturation of the wine takes several years.
ex.zh: 這種酒的熟成需要好幾年。

ex.en: Children's brain maturation continues into their twenties.
ex.zh: 孩子們的大腦發育會持續到二十多歲。

ex.en: The experiment showed how magnetism pulls iron toward a magnet.
ex.zh: 這個實驗展示了磁力如何把鐵吸向磁鐵。

ex.en: Earth's magnetism helps compasses point north.
ex.zh: 地球的磁性讓指南針指向北方。

ex.en: The singer's personal magnetism drew huge crowds.
ex.zh: 那位歌手個人的魅力吸引了大批群眾。

ex.en: Her magnetism made everyone want to talk to her.
ex.zh: 她的魅力讓每個人都想跟她說話。

ex.en: The farmer used a machete to cut through the tall grass.
ex.zh: 農夫用大砍刀砍開長長的草叢。

ex.en: They carried a machete to clear the jungle path.
ex.zh: 他們帶著一把大砍刀來清出叢林小徑。

ex.en: They attended a masquerade where everyone wore a mask.
ex.zh: 他們參加了一場人人戴面具的化裝舞會。

ex.en: His kindness was only a masquerade to hide his plans.
ex.zh: 他的善良不過是用來掩飾計畫的偽裝。

ex.en: The spy masqueraded as a waiter to enter the hall.
ex.zh: 那名間諜假扮成服務生進入大廳。

ex.en: Some websites masquerade as real news.
ex.zh: 有些網站假冒成真正的新聞。

ex.en: Manning the help desk requires at least three staff members.
ex.zh: 要讓服務台運作，至少需要三名人員。

ex.en: Poor manning left the ship short of experienced crew.
ex.zh: 人員配置不足，讓船上缺乏有經驗的船員。

ex.en: She ordered a margarita with salt on the rim.
ex.zh: 她點了一杯杯口沾鹽的瑪格麗特。

ex.en: A margarita is made with tequila and lime juice.
ex.zh: 瑪格麗特是用龍舌蘭酒和萊姆汁調成的。

ex.en: We visited a Mayan temple in Mexico.
ex.zh: 我們在墨西哥參觀了一座馬雅神廟。

ex.en: The Mayan calendar is famous around the world.
ex.zh: 馬雅曆法舉世聞名。

ex.en: The Mayans built great stone cities.
ex.zh: 馬雅人建造了宏偉的石頭城市。

ex.en: A Mayan in the village taught us to weave.
ex.zh: 村裡一位馬雅人教我們編織。

ex.en: A magpie landed on the fence and chattered.
ex.zh: 一隻喜鵲停在籬笆上吱吱喳喳地叫。

ex.en: The magpie is a symbol of good luck in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 喜鵲在台灣是好運的象徵。

ex.en: My grandfather is a magpie who keeps everything.
ex.zh: 我爺爺什麼都留，是個愛蒐集雜物的人。

ex.en: She is a bit of a magpie and fills her room with trinkets.
ex.zh: 她有點愛蒐集小東西，把房間塞滿了小玩意。

ex.en: She reads a fashion mag every month.
ex.zh: 她每個月都會看一本時尚雜誌。

ex.en: I picked up a travel mag at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場買了一本旅遊雜誌。

ex.en: The villain gave a malevolent smile.
ex.zh: 反派露出了惡意的微笑。

ex.en: Children in the story feared the malevolent witch.
ex.zh: 故事裡的孩子們害怕那個心懷惡意的女巫。

maintained.zh: 維持；保持（maintain 的過去式、過去分詞）

ex.en: She maintained a steady pace throughout the race.
ex.zh: 她整場比賽都保持穩定的速度。

ex.en: The two countries maintained good relations for years.
ex.zh: 兩國多年來一直維持良好的關係。

maintained.zh: 保養；維修（maintain 的過去式、過去分詞）

ex.en: The old bridge is well maintained by the city.
ex.zh: 這座老橋由市政府妥善維護。

ex.en: He maintained his car carefully, so it still runs well.
ex.zh: 他細心保養他的車，所以車子還很好開。

maintained.zh: 堅稱（maintain 的過去式、過去分詞）

ex.en: The man maintained that he was innocent.
ex.zh: 那名男子堅稱自己是無辜的。

ex.en: She maintained she had never seen the letter.
ex.zh: 她堅稱自己從沒看過那封信。

ex.en: She got a manicure before the wedding.
ex.zh: 她在婚禮前去做了美甲。

ex.en: A manicure usually takes about forty minutes.
ex.zh: 修指甲通常要花四十分鐘左右。

ex.en: She likes to manicure her nails at home on Sundays.
ex.zh: 她喜歡週日在家修指甲。

ex.en: The salon will manicure your hands and nails carefully.
ex.zh: 美容院會仔細為你修護雙手和指甲。

ex.en: I spread orange marmalade on my toast.
ex.zh: 我在吐司上抹了柳橙果醬。

ex.en: Her grandmother makes marmalade every winter.
ex.zh: 她的祖母每年冬天都會做柑橘果醬。

ex.en: Maryland is a state on the east coast of the United States.
ex.zh: 馬里蘭是美國東岸的一個州。

ex.en: Annapolis is the capital of Maryland.
ex.zh: 安納波利斯是馬里蘭州的首府。

maneuvering.zh: 操縱；巧妙移動（maneuver 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The driver was maneuvering the big truck through the narrow street.
ex.zh: 司機正駕駛大卡車小心地穿過狹窄的街道。

ex.en: She is maneuvering her way into a better position at work.
ex.zh: 她正巧妙地運作，想在公司裡取得更好的職位。

ex.en: Thousands of marchers walked through the city to ask for cleaner air.
ex.zh: 數千名遊行民眾走過市區，呼籲改善空氣品質。

ex.en: Each marcher carried a sign and a bottle of water.
ex.zh: 每位遊行者都拿著一面標語牌和一瓶水。

ex.en: We tried some delicious Malaysian food at the night market.
ex.zh: 我們在夜市吃了一些美味的馬來西亞料理。

ex.en: She works for a Malaysian company in Kuala Lumpur.
ex.zh: 她在吉隆坡的一間馬來西亞公司工作。

ex.en: My roommate is a Malaysian who studies engineering.
ex.zh: 我的室友是一位念工程的馬來西亞人。

ex.en: Many Malaysians speak more than one language.
ex.zh: 許多馬來西亞人會說不只一種語言。

ex.en: I prefer a matte finish for photos because it doesn't reflect light.
ex.zh: 我偏好霧面的相片，因為不會反光。

ex.en: She chose a matte lipstick instead of a shiny one.
ex.zh: 她選了霧面口紅，而不是亮面的。

ex.en: All workers must finish the mandated safety training.
ex.zh: 所有員工都必須完成法定的安全訓練。

ex.en: The company paid the mandated minimum wage to every worker.
ex.zh: 公司付給每位員工法定的最低工資。

ex.en: I like a little mayo on my sandwich.
ex.zh: 我喜歡在三明治上加一點美乃滋。

ex.en: She mixed mayo and mustard to make a sauce.
ex.zh: 她把美乃滋和芥末混合做成醬汁。

ex.en: The accident could have maimed him for life.
ex.zh: 那場意外可能讓他終身殘廢。

ex.en: Safety rules are meant to prevent workers from being maimed.
ex.zh: 安全規範是為了避免工人受到嚴重傷殘。

ex.en: The marquess lived in a large castle in the countryside.
ex.zh: 那位侯爵住在鄉間的一座大城堡裡。

ex.en: In Britain, a marquess ranks above an earl.
ex.zh: 在英國，侯爵的爵位高於伯爵。

materialist.zh: 唯物主義者；重視物質享受的人

ex.en: As a strict materialist, he believes only physical things are real.
ex.zh: 身為嚴格的唯物主義者，他相信只有物質的東西才是真實的。

ex.en: The novel pokes fun at a materialist who cares only about money.
ex.zh: 這部小說嘲諷一個只在乎金錢的物質主義者。

ex.en: She had a mastectomy after the doctors found a tumor.
ex.zh: 醫生發現腫瘤後，她接受了乳房切除手術。

ex.en: Recovery from a mastectomy can take several weeks.
ex.zh: 乳房切除術後的恢復可能需要好幾週。

ex.en: Some people think modern society is too materialistic.
ex.zh: 有些人認為現代社會太過物質主義。

ex.en: He is so materialistic that he only talks about cars and money.
ex.zh: 他太拜金了，開口閉口都是車子和錢。

ex.en: We saw the matinee because the tickets were cheaper.
ex.zh: 我們看了日場，因為票比較便宜。

ex.en: There is a Saturday matinee at two o'clock.
ex.zh: 週六下午兩點有一場日場演出。

ex.en: The manatee is a slow, gentle sea animal.
ex.zh: 海牛是一種行動緩慢、性情溫和的海洋動物。

ex.en: We saw a manatee swimming near the boat.
ex.zh: 我們看到一隻海牛在船邊游著。

ex.en: The maestro raised his baton and the orchestra began to play.
ex.zh: 大師舉起指揮棒，樂團開始演奏。

ex.en: The audience applauded the maestro for several minutes.
ex.zh: 觀眾為這位大師鼓掌了好幾分鐘。

ex.en: The Maya built tall stone temples in Central America.
ex.zh: 馬雅人在中美洲建造了高聳的石造神殿。

ex.en: Many Maya still live in Guatemala and southern Mexico.
ex.zh: 許多馬雅人至今仍住在瓜地馬拉和墨西哥南部。

ex.en: We visited an ancient Maya city in the jungle.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了叢林裡的一座古馬雅城市。

ex.en: The Maya calendar is famous for its complex system.
ex.zh: 馬雅曆法以其複雜的系統聞名。

ex.en: A male mallard has a shiny green head.
ex.zh: 公的綠頭鴨有一個閃亮的綠色頭部。

ex.en: We fed bread to a mallard at the pond.
ex.zh: 我們在池塘邊餵了一隻綠頭鴨麵包。

ex.en: Manila is the capital of the Philippines.
ex.zh: 馬尼拉是菲律賓的首都。

ex.en: The flight from Taipei to Manila takes about two hours.
ex.zh: 從台北飛到馬尼拉大約要兩個小時。

ex.en: The coach wants maximal effort from every player.
ex.zh: 教練要求每位球員都全力以赴。

ex.en: This setting gives maximal brightness but drains the battery fast.
ex.zh: 這個設定能提供最大亮度，但會很快耗電。

ex.en: Plants need maximal sunlight to grow well in spring.
ex.zh: 植物在春天需要最充足的陽光才能長得好。

marlowe.zh: 馬洛（英國伊莉莎白時代劇作家）

ex.en: Christopher Marlowe was an English playwright and poet.
ex.zh: 克里斯多福．馬洛是英國劇作家兼詩人。

ex.en: Marlowe lived in the same era as Shakespeare.
ex.zh: 馬洛與莎士比亞生活在同一時代。

ex.en: The magnolia in our yard blooms every spring.
ex.zh: 我們院子裡的木蘭樹每年春天都會開花。

ex.en: Large white magnolia flowers covered the branches.
ex.zh: 白色的大朵木蘭花開滿了枝頭。

ex.en: He caught a huge marlin off the coast.
ex.zh: 他在海邊釣到一條巨大的馬林魚。

ex.en: A marlin can swim very fast.
ex.zh: 馬林魚游得非常快。

matched.zh: 相配；符合（match 的過去式）

ex.en: Her shoes matched her dress perfectly.
ex.zh: 她的鞋子和洋裝非常相配。

ex.en: The police matched the fingerprints to the suspect.
ex.zh: 警方把指紋與嫌犯比對相符。

ex.en: They are an evenly matched pair of players.
ex.zh: 他們是一對實力相當的選手。

ex.en: The couple wore matched sweaters.
ex.zh: 這對情侶穿著成套搭配的毛衣。

ex.en: The little girl ran to her mamma and gave her a hug.
ex.zh: 小女孩跑向她的媽媽，給了她一個擁抱。

ex.en: Mamma is cooking dinner in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 媽媽正在廚房煮晚餐。

ex.en: He tapped the tent peg into the ground with a wooden mallet.
ex.zh: 他用木槌把帳篷釘敲進地裡。

ex.en: The judge struck the table with a mallet.
ex.zh: 法官用槌子敲了一下桌子。

marseille.zh: 馬賽（法國南部的港口城市）

ex.en: Marseille is a large port city in southern France.
ex.zh: 馬賽是法國南部的一座大港口城市。

ex.en: We took a train from Paris to Marseille.
ex.zh: 我們搭火車從巴黎到馬賽。

ex.en: Mali is a large country in West Africa.
ex.zh: 馬利是西非的一個大國。

ex.en: The capital of Mali is Bamako.
ex.zh: 馬利的首都是巴馬科。

ex.en: The jet flew at Mach 2, twice the speed of sound.
ex.zh: 那架噴射機以二馬赫飛行，是音速的兩倍。

ex.en: Mach 1 is about the speed of sound.
ex.zh: 一馬赫大約等於音速。

ex.en: She painted the door a bright shade of magenta.
ex.zh: 她把門漆成鮮豔的洋紅色。

ex.en: Magenta is a mixture of red and blue light.
ex.zh: 洋紅色是紅光與藍光混合而成的。

ex.en: The printer ran out of magenta ink.
ex.zh: 印表機的洋紅色墨水用完了。

ex.en: The cake was covered with a thin layer of marzipan.
ex.zh: 蛋糕上覆蓋著薄薄一層杏仁膏。

ex.en: She made little fruits out of colored marzipan.
ex.zh: 她用彩色杏仁膏做了小水果。

ex.en: Marzipan is made from ground almonds and sugar.
ex.zh: 杏仁膏是用杏仁粉和糖做成的。

ex.en: The choir sang a lovely madrigal from the sixteenth century.
ex.zh: 合唱團演唱了一首十六世紀的優美牧歌。

ex.en: A madrigal is usually sung by a small group without instruments.
ex.zh: 牧歌通常由小團體不用樂器演唱。

ex.en: Magma rises from deep inside the earth during an eruption.
ex.zh: 火山爆發時，岩漿從地底深處湧上來。

ex.en: When magma cools, it turns into solid rock.
ex.zh: 岩漿冷卻後會變成堅硬的岩石。

ex.en: The Mariana Trench is the deepest part of the ocean.
ex.zh: 馬里亞納海溝是海洋最深的地方。

ex.en: Guam is part of the Mariana Islands.
ex.zh: 關島屬於馬里亞納群島。

ex.en: The dentist checked the patient's mandible after the fall.
ex.zh: 病人跌倒後，牙醫檢查了他的下頜骨。

ex.en: Beetles use their strong mandibles to cut leaves.
ex.zh: 甲蟲用強壯的大顎來咬斷葉子。

ex.en: She picked a marguerite from the field and smiled.
ex.zh: 她從田裡摘了一朵雛菊，露出微笑。

ex.en: White marguerites grew along the garden path.
ex.zh: 白色的雛菊沿著花園小徑生長。

ex.en: Bright orange marigolds filled the front garden.
ex.zh: 鮮橘色的萬壽菊開滿了前院。

ex.en: We planted marigolds to keep insects away from the vegetables.
ex.zh: 我們種了萬壽菊來讓蟲子遠離蔬菜。

ex.en: The emperor was buried in a huge marble mausoleum.
ex.zh: 皇帝被葬在一座巨大的大理石陵墓裡。

ex.en: Tourists lined up to visit the mausoleum.
ex.zh: 遊客排隊參觀那座陵墓。

ex.en: Police launched a massive manhunt for the escaped prisoner.
ex.zh: 警方對逃獄的囚犯展開大規模搜捕。

ex.en: The manhunt ended when he was found hiding in a barn.
ex.zh: 他被發現躲在穀倉裡，搜捕行動才告一段落。

ex.en: She used a magnifying glass to read the tiny print.
ex.zh: 她用放大鏡讀那些小字。

ex.en: The detective examined the clue with a magnifying lens.
ex.zh: 偵探用放大鏡檢查那條線索。

ex.en: The microscope is magnifying the cells by a hundred times.
ex.zh: 顯微鏡正把細胞放大一百倍。

ex.en: Social media is magnifying the problem.
ex.zh: 社群媒體正在放大這個問題。

ex.en: The waiter was friendly and matey with all the customers.
ex.zh: 服務生對所有客人都親切友善。

ex.en: He gave a matey smile and sat down beside us.
ex.zh: 他親切地笑了笑，在我們旁邊坐下。

malleable.zh: 有延展性的；易受影響的

ex.en: Gold is a soft, malleable metal.
ex.zh: 黃金是一種柔軟、有延展性的金屬。

ex.en: Young minds are malleable and easily influenced.
ex.zh: 年輕人的心智可塑性高，容易受影響。

ex.en: The castle stood magnificently on the hill.
ex.zh: 城堡雄偉壯麗地矗立在山丘上。

ex.en: The choir sang magnificently last night.
ex.zh: 合唱團昨晚唱得精彩極了。

ex.en: The machinist adjusted the lathe carefully.
ex.zh: 機械工小心地調整車床。

ex.en: He trained for years to become a machinist.
ex.zh: 他受訓多年才成為機械工。

ex.en: The doctor said the scan showed no sign of malignancy.
ex.zh: 醫生說掃描結果沒有惡性腫瘤的跡象。

ex.en: Early tests can help find a malignancy before it spreads.
ex.zh: 早期檢查有助於在惡性腫瘤擴散前發現它。

ex.en: Doctors advise women over forty to have regular mammography.
ex.zh: 醫生建議四十歲以上的女性定期做乳房攝影檢查。

ex.en: The clinic offers free mammography once a year.
ex.zh: 這間診所每年提供一次免費的乳房攝影檢查。

ex.en: Massed crowds filled the square to watch the parade.
ex.zh: 聚集的人群擠滿廣場觀看遊行。

ex.en: The massed choir sang together in the large hall.
ex.zh: 合唱團成員齊聚一堂，在大廳裡一起歌唱。

ex.en: The mailman puts the letters in our box every morning.
ex.zh: 郵差每天早上把信放進我們的信箱。

ex.en: Our dog barks every time the mailman comes to the gate.
ex.zh: 每次郵差來到門口，我們的狗都會叫。

ex.en: The careful manoeuvring of the ship took nearly an hour.
ex.zh: 這艘船小心的操控花了將近一小時。

ex.en: There was a lot of political manoeuvring before the vote.
ex.zh: 投票前有許多政治上的角力運作。

ex.en: Visitors were amazed by the magnificence of the palace.
ex.zh: 遊客對宮殿的宏偉感到驚嘆。

ex.en: The magnificence of the mountain view took our breath away.
ex.zh: 山景的壯麗讓我們屏息。

ex.en: The machine mangled his sleeve.
ex.zh: 機器把他的袖子絞爛了。

ex.en: The car was mangled in the crash.
ex.zh: 那輛車在撞擊中被撞得面目全非。

ex.en: The matriarch of the family cooks for everyone on holidays.
ex.zh: 這個家族的女家長在假日為所有人做飯。

ex.en: Our grandmother is the matriarch who keeps us together.
ex.zh: 我們的祖母是凝聚全家的女家長。

ex.en: The ship was pulled into a maelstrom in the sea.
ex.zh: 船被捲進海中的大漩渦。

ex.en: She was caught in a maelstrom of work and family duties.
ex.zh: 她被捲入工作與家庭責任的混亂之中。

ex.en: He lost his job because of her machinations.
ex.zh: 他因為她的陰謀而丟了工作。

ex.en: The film is about the machinations of a power-hungry advisor.
ex.zh: 這部電影講的是一位權力欲強的顧問的種種陰謀。

mannered.zh: 舉止有禮的；矯揉造作的

ex.en: He was a soft-spoken and well mannered young man.
ex.zh: 他是個說話輕聲細語、舉止有禮的年輕人。

ex.en: The actor's mannered style made the performance feel stiff and unnatural.
ex.zh: 那位演員矯揉造作的風格讓表演顯得僵硬不自然。

ex.en: She turned out to be a clever manipulator who always got her way.
ex.zh: 她原來是個善於操弄別人、總能如願的人。

ex.en: Be careful with him, he is a skilled manipulator.
ex.zh: 要小心他，他很會操控別人。

mangled.zh: 嚴重損壞；弄爛（mangle 的過去式）

ex.en: The machine mangled my sleeve and almost pulled in my arm.
ex.zh: 機器把我的袖子絞爛了，差點把我的手臂也捲進去。

ex.en: The tourist mangled the pronunciation of the street name.
ex.zh: 那位遊客把街名的發音念得亂七八糟。

ex.en: The marshy ground made it hard to build a road.
ex.zh: 沼澤般的濕軟地面讓修路很困難。

ex.en: Frogs and birds live in the marshy area near the river.
ex.zh: 青蛙和鳥類生活在河邊的沼澤地帶。

ex.en: The old tradition had a malign influence on young people.
ex.zh: 這個舊傳統對年輕人有不良影響。

ex.en: She felt a malign look from across the room.
ex.zh: 她感覺到房間另一頭投來的惡意目光。

ex.en: He felt unfairly maligned by the newspaper.
ex.zh: 他覺得報紙對他不公平地中傷。

ex.en: Don't malign your coworkers behind their backs.
ex.zh: 不要在背後說同事的壞話。

ex.en: The pianist gave a masterly performance.
ex.zh: 鋼琴家演出得非常精湛。

ex.en: He handled the difficult negotiation in a masterly way.
ex.zh: 他以高明的手法處理了這場困難的談判。

ex.en: The project has manifold benefits for the community.
ex.zh: 這個計畫對社區有多方面的好處。

ex.en: Her reasons for leaving were manifold.
ex.zh: 她離開的原因有很多種。

ex.en: The mechanic replaced a cracked exhaust manifold.
ex.zh: 技師換掉了裂開的排氣歧管。

ex.en: The engine's intake manifold carries air to each cylinder.
ex.zh: 引擎的進氣歧管把空氣送到每個汽缸。

marinated.zh: 醃泡（marinate 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: I marinated the chicken in soy sauce overnight.
ex.zh: 我把雞肉用醬油醃了一整晚。

ex.en: The marinated fish tasted rich and a little sweet.
ex.zh: 醃過的魚吃起來味道濃郁又帶點甜。

ex.en: The doctors treated several malnourished children.
ex.zh: 醫生們治療了幾位營養不良的孩子。

ex.en: A diet of only bread left him malnourished.
ex.zh: 只吃麵包的飲食使他營養不良。

ex.en: A bear mauled the campers' tent and ate all their food.
ex.zh: 一隻熊把露營者的帳篷撕爛，還吃光了他們的食物。

ex.en: The critics mauled the movie, calling it dull and far too long.
ex.zh: 評論家把這部電影批得體無完膚，說它無聊又太長。

ex.en: He split the log with a heavy maul.
ex.zh: 他用一把沉重的大木槌劈開了那根木頭。

ex.en: The old maul hung on the wall of the barn.
ex.zh: 那把舊的大木槌掛在穀倉的牆上。

ex.en: A pine marten ran quickly up the tree and disappeared.
ex.zh: 一隻松貂迅速爬上樹就不見了。

ex.en: The marten is a small animal with soft, thick fur.
ex.zh: 貂是一種毛皮柔軟濃密的小動物。

ex.en: Marauding bands once attacked travelers along this road.
ex.zh: 過去有成群的劫匪在這條路上襲擊旅人。

ex.en: The farmers feared the marauding wolves that came at night.
ex.zh: 農夫們害怕夜裡出沒、四處掠食的狼群。

ex.en: Workers climbed down through the manhole into the tunnel.
ex.zh: 工人從人孔爬下進入隧道。

ex.en: Don't step on the loose manhole cover.
ex.zh: 別踩到鬆動的人孔蓋。

madison.zh: （美國威斯康辛州首府）麥迪遜

ex.en: Madison is the capital city of the state of Wisconsin.
ex.zh: 麥迪遜是威斯康辛州的首府。

ex.en: We drove to Madison to visit the university campus.
ex.zh: 我們開車去麥迪遜參觀大學校園。

ex.en: Marylebone is an area in central London.
ex.zh: 馬里波恩是倫敦市中心的一個區域。

ex.en: There is a famous railway station in Marylebone.
ex.zh: 馬里波恩有一座著名的火車站。

ex.en: The maturing market has attracted many new companies.
ex.zh: 逐漸成熟的市場吸引了許多新公司進入。

ex.en: He is a maturing athlete who plays more calmly each season.
ex.zh: 他是一位逐漸成熟的運動員，每個球季打得都更沉穩。

maturing.zh: 成熟；陳放（mature 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The cheese is maturing in a cool cellar.
ex.zh: 起司正在涼爽的地窖裡熟成。

ex.en: Our daughter is maturing quickly and has become more responsible.
ex.zh: 我們的女兒成長得很快，變得更有責任感了。

ex.en: The farmer filled the manger with fresh hay.
ex.zh: 農夫在飼料槽裡裝滿新鮮乾草。

ex.en: The horse bent its head over the manger to eat.
ex.zh: 馬低下頭在馬槽邊吃東西。

ex.en: The old Masonic hall stands in the center of town.
ex.zh: 那座老共濟會會所位在鎮中心。

ex.en: He wore a Masonic ring to the ceremony.
ex.zh: 他戴著共濟會戒指出席典禮。

ex.en: He maliciously spread a rumor about his coworker.
ex.zh: 他惡意散播關於同事的謠言。

ex.en: The files were maliciously deleted by someone inside the company.
ex.zh: 這些檔案被公司內部的某人惡意刪除了。

ex.en: She smiled maliciously when he made a mistake.
ex.zh: 他犯錯時，她不懷好意地笑了。

majorca.zh: 馬約卡島（西班牙的島嶼）

ex.en: Majorca is a Spanish island in the Mediterranean Sea.
ex.zh: 馬約卡島是地中海上的一座西班牙島嶼。

ex.en: Many tourists visit Majorca for its beaches.
ex.zh: 許多遊客為了海灘前往馬約卡島。

ex.en: The old clock still works marvelously.
ex.zh: 那座老時鐘仍運轉得極好。

ex.en: She sang marvelously at the school concert.
ex.zh: 她在學校音樂會上唱得精彩極了。

ex.en: The judge questioned the materiality of the evidence.
ex.zh: 法官質疑該證據的重要性。

ex.en: Auditors consider the materiality of each error in the accounts.
ex.zh: 審計人員會評估帳目中每項錯誤的重大程度。

ex.en: He found a matchbox in the kitchen drawer.
ex.zh: 他在廚房抽屜裡找到一盒火柴。

ex.en: The little car was no bigger than a matchbox.
ex.zh: 那輛小車子不比火柴盒大。

ex.en: He lit the candle with a single matchstick.
ex.zh: 他用一根火柴棒點燃了蠟燭。

ex.en: The kids built a tiny house out of matchsticks.
ex.zh: 孩子們用火柴棒蓋了一間小房子。

ex.en: The winner was magnanimous and praised his rival.
ex.zh: 獲勝者很大方地稱讚了他的對手。

ex.en: It was magnanimous of her to forgive them so quickly.
ex.zh: 她這麼快就原諒他們，真是寬宏大量。

ex.en: Three workers had to manhandle the piano up the stairs.
ex.zh: 三名工人得用人力把鋼琴搬上樓。

ex.en: The guards were accused of manhandling the protesters.
ex.zh: 警衛被指控粗暴對待抗議者。

ex.en: The lion opened its huge maw and roared.
ex.zh: 獅子張開巨口怒吼。

ex.en: The tunnel looked like the maw of a giant beast.
ex.zh: 那條隧道看起來像巨獸的大口。

ex.en: Please make sure the door is locked before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前請確認門有鎖好。

ex.en: I called the restaurant to make sure they had a table for us.
ex.zh: 我打電話給餐廳確認他們有留位子給我們。

ex.en: Make sure you bring your passport to the airport.
ex.zh: 一定要記得把護照帶去機場。

make sure.en: to check that something is true or to make certain that it happens

ex.en: He made up a story about why he was late.
ex.zh: 他編了個故事來解釋為什麼遲到。

ex.en: The kids like to make up songs in the car.
ex.zh: 孩子們喜歡在車上自己編歌。

make up.en: to invent a story or an excuse that is not true

ex.en: They had a fight, but they made up the next day.
ex.zh: 他們吵了一架，但隔天就和好了。

ex.en: It's time to make up and be friends again.
ex.zh: 該和好、重新做朋友了。

make up.en: to become friends again after an argument

ex.en: I'll work extra hours to make up the time I lost.
ex.zh: 我會多加幾個小時的班來補回損失的時間。

ex.en: She took a class to make up the missing credits.
ex.zh: 她修了一堂課來補足缺的學分。

make up.en: to do something to replace time or work that was lost

ex.en: Girls make up most of the class.
ex.zh: 女生占了班上的大多數。

ex.en: Water makes up about sixty percent of the human body.
ex.zh: 水約占人體的百分之六十。

make up.en: to be the parts that together form a whole

ex.en: Even a small donation can make a difference to someone in need.
ex.zh: 即使是小額捐款，也能為需要幫助的人帶來改變。

ex.en: Her kind words really made a difference on my worst day.
ex.zh: 她親切的話在我最糟的那天幫了我很大的忙。

ex.en: Does it make a difference if we leave an hour later?
ex.zh: 我們晚一個小時出發有差嗎？

make a difference.en: to have an effect on something or someone, especially a good one
